comments.author: @ExploreTravelDocs
comments.text:
I've traveled all over the world, but Antarctica remains the one frontier I haven't braved yet. This video is absolutely fascinating, but it left me completely torn: is experiencing that kind of breathtaking, untouched isolation actually worth enduring the extreme cold and months of darkness?

If you were offered an all-expenses-paid trip to live and work down there for a whole season, would you actually take it, or is it just too intense for the average person? I honestly can't decide—what do you guys think?
